title: Cory Johnson:
length: about 14 s (the real lines run about 10 s)
headline: Cory thanks the donor himself, face to camera: what they gave makes an everlasting change for Native women and communities.
story: Cory asked for this clip himself on camera. NIWRC sends it to donors after Domestic Violence Awareness Month. Three lines and a smile: the thanks, what the gift does, “Thank you.”

Loops: L1 “Who is thanking me, and for what?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 00:05 on “to support Native women and communities”. L2 “What did my gift change?” opens at 0:00 and closes on “everlasting change”. Stakes: safety and sovereignty for Native women and communities. The donor made it possible.
do: Open on Cory mid-sentence with <q>THIS ONE IS FOR YOU</q> already on screen at 0:00.
Use the C1 Event 3 sound for every line (live mic), also under the C2 angle.
Name super at 00:03, lower left, 2.5 s: Cory Johnson / Development and Strategic Impact Officer, NIWRC.
Let him finish the smile after “Thank you.”, about 1 s, then the end card.
Match the pacing, captions and color of your Kerri and tai thank-you clips. The three post as a set.
dont: Do not open with “Hi, my name is Cory Johnson…”. His name and title go on the super.
No cutaways, no reception footage, no programs list, nothing sad.
No “Good.” and no laugh after “Thank you.”.
No logo, name card or fade at 0:00.
No Tribal affiliation on the super. Name and title only.

None by plan: a face-to-camera thank-you, like the Kerri and tai clips.
NIWRC package: Drive deliverables/graphics-packages/NIWRC. Folder link not available in this run. Type the words on the empty plates in Source Sans 3.
Oswald and Source Sans 3. NIWRC red #981C20, purple #4D3271, light base #E7DED5, near black #231F20.
Native music only if it is made AND performed by a verified US Native artist. Otherwise a neutral instrumental. Music never competes with the voice.
tech: Two Sony cameras, 3840×2160, 23.976 fps (visual.json). C1 Event 3 is wide, C2 Event 3 is medium.

C1 = live mic. On his interview (C1 Event 1) it measured about -27 dB mean, peaks -7 dB, dual mono. C2 = camera mic. Use C1 sound for every line. He is outdoors with a cafe behind him: level pass and light noise reduction.
4K 16:9. A 9:16 crop is 1215×2160, so it is scaled down, never up. C1 is wide (his face is small in frame): punch in up to about 1.5× and check sharpness.
-14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP peak. Music always under the voice (client rule: music never competes with the voice).
Burned in, low in the frame, Source Sans 3 bold, white with a soft shadow, in your approved NIWRC caption template. Capital N in “Native”. “Cory” is C-O-R-Y.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, 9:16. Upload to Frame.io → Ready for Review.
